content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

This is a self-hosted commerce stack designed for digital creators in regions where payment processors are restricted. It combines free and paid tools into a single system: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. The system automates product delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain. You own the entire stack. No platform can shut you down. No subscription fees. No revenue share. This isn’t a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure. Built to withstand payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation. Pressure-tested in Zimbabwe. Deployed globally.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates in three layers: hosting, payment processing, and delivery. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which process orders and trigger file delivery. Payments are verified via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a 0.5% fee. Once payment confirms, the system automatically sends a secure download link to the buyer. Order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on the stack. File delivery uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Every component is replaceable. Every step is transparent. You control the entire flow. No black boxes. No dependencies on third-party APIs.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. If you’re in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or similar regions, this stack gives you the infrastructure to sell globally. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent their commerce stack. You own the code. You own the data. You own the customer relationship. No platform can change your terms, raise your fees, or shut you down. This is for creators who choose sovereignty over convenience. Who choose ownership over dependency.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for static hosting—both free and scalable. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, depending on the stack. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. Order data is stored in Supabase (for Edge Commerce Stack) or Google Sheets (for Sovereign Starter Stack). File delivery uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both secure and reliable. The Complete Builder Kit includes blueprints for all stacks, source code, and deployment templates. Every component is chosen for reliability, cost, and sovereignty. No hidden fees. No vendor lock-in. Full ownership from day one.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all blueprints, source code, and templates. Choose your stack based on your needs: Sovereign Starter Stack for simplicity or Edge Commerce Stack for scalability. Deploy to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure NOWPayments for your preferred cryptocurrencies (BSC, Solana, or TRON recommended for low fees). Test end-to-end. Load your products. Go live. The kit includes a 30-day support window. No technical debt. No ongoing costs. Own your commerce infrastructure. Sell globally. No Stripe required.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
